incidents.what: Default preflight FAILED (tranche: history must be a list ending with the current status) after the first BUILD continuity sync; history entry corrected to end with BUILD before any commit. Acknowledgment commit ac10f30 was made only after the corrected preflight passed 7/7 (default and origin/main..HEAD).

Recovery script first failed an assertion (M05 reverse replacement not unique) and then had a quoting defect; neither produced output used here. Rewritten to forward-apply each recorded replacement to the BUILD blob and require byte equality with the surviving mutated copy.

First replay campaign was started through Windows PowerShell 5.1, which writes UTF-16 logs the summarizer cannot parse; stopped, its task-owned DB container, test container and network were removed, and it was restarted through PowerShell 7. A second start was also stopped and cleaned to add a Go build-cache volume. No result from those aborted runs is used.
One combined shell command (cache edit plus restart) was refused by the tool path guard before executing; the steps were reissued individually with literal paths.
Mutant N04 (Update notified_at to nil) failed to compile ('declared and not used: now') - a BUILD_ERROR, not a kill and not a survivor. Retained unmodified; compiling variant N04b was run and killed.

First N05e attempt ran the four notification tests because the harness did not apply the engine selection (harness defect, duplicates N05). Retained as N05e-attempt1; corrected run N05e used the engine ownership selection.

N05 (cancelled run allowed to notify) SURVIVED the four notification tests. Expected: the cancelled single-conversation run has no analyzed result. The engine ownership selection kills the same mutant (N05e, TestCancelAfterPartialProgressDoesNotNotify). The MCP/HTTP cancellation control therefore remains a preserved zero-notification control, not a mutation-discriminated one.

Initial cold-cache baseline replay took about five minutes; a task-named Docker volume (ccma-r044-gocache) now holds only the Go build cache. Persistent application containers (ccma-app-1, ccma-db-1, ccma-nginx-1) were not inspected, entered or used.
